leela: spun up tangram-lite-v1 (int6) to staging for embeddings onboarding. quick cluster sanity shows weird blob merging in UMAP and silhouette drop ~0.12 vs fp32. posting eval snippets — anyone seen quant cause topology collapse like this?

max: can you paste the commands + metrics? also which quant backend + mode?

leela: ran the standard pipeline:
```
python tools/eval_embeddings.py --model tangram-lite-v1 --quant int6 --dataset cluster-holdout --ann hnsw --ef 200 --umap --silhouette
```
summary:
```
baseline fp32: recall@1=0.891, recall@5=0.962, silhouette=0.38
int6 (default per-tensor): recall@1=0.854, recall@5=0.942, silhouette=0.26  # -0.12 sil
avg intra-cluster dist: 0.48 -> 0.39 (compressed)
```

carter: compression of distances + silhouette drop suggests quant scales collapsed inter-cluster gaps. two suspects: per-tensor quant or a change in whitening/unit-norm. did you run pairwise distance histograms?

nora: also check UMAP params — stochastic embedding can vary a bit. but a 0.12 silhouette hit is large. try per-channel quant and run kNN precision/recall curve + pairwise delta histogram.

leela: re-ran with per-channel int6 + disabled on-the-fly whitening (we rely on stored transform). command:
```
python tools/eval_embeddings.py --model tangram-lite-v1 --quant int6 --quant-mode per-channel --dataset cluster-holdout --ann hnsw --ef 350 --umap --silhouette --export-dists=small_dump.csv
```
new metrics:
```
recall@1=0.887, recall@5=0.959, silhouette=0.355
avg intra-cluster dist: 0.49 -> 0.47
pairwise delta median: 0.02 (was 0.06 per-tensor)
```
this recovers most of the loss. UMAP now shows distinct clusters again. exported CSV attached.

max: that aligns — per-channel keeps relative scales across dims so topology is preserved. ef=350 also helps recovery. action items: 1) update model catalog to prefer per-channel int6 for tangram-lite-v1, 2) add a clustering-quality smoke in onboarding checks (silhouette threshold relative to fp32, e.g. -0.05), 3) add a histogram export of pairwise deltas to help triage. i'll draft PRs.

carter: one more suggestion — for embeddings used in clustering we should test both recall@k and silhouette/DB indices in the eval harness. sometimes recall masks structure collapse. can we add DB index and a small UMAP snapshot to artifacts?

eval-bot: regression-detected: silhouette delta=-0.125 vs baseline on dataset=cluster-holdout. severity=medium. ticket=ML-4780.

nora: agreed on DB index + UMAP artifact; also add a note in model onboarding checklist: "verify quant-mode per-channel for low-dim dense layers". i'll update the checklist.

leela: cool thanks. kicking off a 7-seed stability sweep (different RNG + HNSW seeds) and will upload aggregate metrics + sample UMAP images to the ticket. :sparkles:
